decision: Every delete or remove action asks first in one reusable confirmation dialog (AlertDialog, front-end/src/components/confirm-dialog.tsx): title names the thing, destructive button names the action, focus on Cancel. Starts with removing a cart line
why: Owner: remove from cart needs a confirmation; any delete action must use a reusable confirmation first

decision: Adding to cart gives feedback: the item flies into the cart button, the badge bumps, and a toast says it was added with a View cart action
why: Owner: no indicator after adding to cart

decision: M03 tab ids = status search param: awaiting-confirmation (default), awaiting-payment, preparing, ready, owing, completed, cancelled; exported as ORDER_TABS; unknown values fall back to the default
why: M02 task cards deep-link to a tab; coordinator approved the values

decision: Tabs partition every order: owing = all handed_over orders (including one already paid but not yet completed); declined orders sit in Cancelled
why: Spec §3.2 has 7 tabs and no Declined tab; no order should be hidden

decision: M03 rows show the pickup date as a short date ('Tue 20 Oct' / 'Di., 20. Okt.'); payment labels keep the numeric dates from T0
why: A list row is a card-like summary; the weekday helps plan pickups. Order documents keep 14.10.2026

decision: Sort: open tabs soonest pickup first; Completed and Cancelled latest pickup first; ties by reference
why: Staff work through upcoming pickups; closed tabs are history

decision: Desktop Table has 4 columns (Order = guest + ref, Gifts, Status = both chips stacked, Pickup = date + place) instead of one column per field
why: At 1024px the content area beside the 256px sidebar is ~700px; separate columns for two long chips would scroll sideways

decision: Tab counts as a small grey number pill after the label; selected tab deep-linked from M02 scrolls into view
why: Tabs card: list scrolls sideways; the selected tab must be visible

decision: Product summary per row: '{qty} × {first product}' plus '+N more' for further lines; tab names EN Awaiting confirmation / Awaiting payment / Preparing / Ready / Balance owed / Completed / Cancelled, DE Wartet auf Bestätigung / Wartet auf Zahlung / In Vorbereitung / Abholbereit / Restbetrag offen / Abgeschlossen / Storniert
why: Spec §3.2 tab names translated

decision: Quantity stepper: no focus halo after tapping minus or plus (the tap moves focus into the field); the halo still shows for keyboard focus (data-focus-visible)
why: Owner: remove the outline when pressing the buttons

decision: Gift card overlays (price, Engraving badge, heart) use a solid warm-white pill with ink text and a soft shadow (pill utility, Airbnb 'Guest favorite' pill) instead of frosted glass. Supersedes glass on cards; the detail photo's back, heart and cart buttons and the gallery counter still use glass
why: Owner: glass had too little contrast

decision: Card overlay pill matches airbnb.com's 'Guest favorite' badge (measured on the live home page): white 80% with backdrop blur 32px, 0.8px white 50% hairline, three-layer soft shadow; text in our charcoal ink. Supersedes the solid pill
why: Owner: Airbnb's overlay is not solid white

decision: Detail photo buttons (back, heart, cart) and photo counter use the pill style instead of grey glass
why: Owner: same style as the product card icons
evidence: gift-detail.tsx, cart-button.tsx tone pill, photo-gallery.tsx counter

decision: C03 add confirms with a HeroUI success toast ('Added to cart', '{name} · {variant} × {quantity}', action 'View cart'), auto-dismiss 6s (paused on hover/focus), visible close; a new add replaces the previous cart toast. Exception to Toast card D2 (toasts with an action stay until closed)
why: Owner asked for a toast; 'View cart' is repeated inline in the bar, so the action is not the only path (WCAG 2.2.1 reason behind D2 is covered); sticky toasts would stack on every add. Coordinator approved

decision: Supersedes row 61 ('confirms inline, not with a toast'): inline bar confirmation stays, toast added on top
why: Owner request 1.4b

decision: Fly-to-cart: 40px product thumbnail flies 650ms on an arc from the sheet's add button into the visible cart button; badge keeps the old count until it lands, then pops (scale 1.4, 300ms). Skipped with reduced motion or when no cart button is on screen
why: Owner request; transform/opacity only, no layout shift

decision: App toast region: bottom, safe-area + 96px (clears C03 bottom bar and tab bar), width min(398px, 100vw-2rem), localised region and close labels
why: HeroUI default bottom-4 covers the bars; HeroUI 460px min width overflows the 430px frame; HeroUI close label is English only

decision: Toast close button 24px and always visible on the front toast (Toast card 'Our changes'), added to components.css
why: Touch users never hover

decision: C15 order: header (photo, name, progress + payment chips), state notice, action block, then pickup, gifts and amounts, payment history, progress timeline, policy at the time of ordering, contact with copyable reference
why: The guest's three questions (confirmed? paid/owed? done?) are answered above the fold; reference material below

decision: C15 actions sit inline under the state notice, not in a fixed bottom bar
why: Most states have no primary action; an empty or changing bottom bar would jump between states

decision: Every C15 action is gated on its T0 guard: Pay = startOnlinePaymentBlock (so no second Pay while processing), Cancel = cancelBlock(guest), Request again = cancelled orders only, review slot = completed only
why: One source of truth for what is allowed; the screen never re-derives order rules

decision: Pickup heading: "Requested pickup" while requested or declined, "Confirmed pickup" from acceptance, "Pickup (cancelled)" when cancelled
why: Spec §1.3: requested dates are requests until the seller accepts

decision: R04 note on C15 shows when the shop changed date or place and the guest can still cancel (same gate as C14), names the old and new place, marked as a proposal
why: R04 free cancel is a UX proposal; once paid the note would promise something T0 blocks

decision: Timeline = logged steps with demo times, then upcoming milestones (Seller confirms / You pay, then the shop prepares / Ready for pickup / Picked up and paid); pay later skips the pay milestone; closed orders show no upcoming steps
why: Shows what has happened and what comes next without a response-time promise (R03)

decision: Request again adds each line back to the cart with its original date and place and opens C04; an outdated date is then fixed with C04's invalid-date button
why: Spec §4.2 and outline: nothing is re-sent automatically; reuses the 1.5 fix rather than a new date picker

decision: C15 shows only the signed-in guest's own orders; any other order id shows "We couldn't find this order in your account."
why: Spec §1.7 personal data stays within its role

decision: Late money on a cancelled order: warning notice "{amount} arrived after the order was cancelled · the shop is checking it", and the payment row reads "Received after cancellation · awaiting reconciliation"
why: S3/R05: the order is not restored; the guest needs to know the money is seen

decision: Contact block: reference in monospace, selectable, with a Copy button and "Copied" live feedback; Email (subject carries the reference) and Call
why: Spec C15: contact the shop with the order reference as copyable text

decision: Prototype control "Add sample orders in every state" (signed in): eight orders for Anna built only with T0 transitions, their emails dropped; Reset removes them
why: Steps 1.7, 1.11, 1.14 and 1.15 do not exist yet, and seeding live orders would change stock and merchant queues for everyone

decision: Prototype control "Expire this order's payment deadline" acts on the order on screen, disabled with a hint unless T0 cancelBlock(overdue) allows it
why: Outline §4; only accepted orders with nothing paid can expire

decision: Every delete, remove or cancel goes through one shared ConfirmDialog/useConfirm (src/components/confirm-dialog.tsx); no one-off confirm dialogs
why: Owner rule: any delete action asks first, with a reusable dialog

decision: The confirm dialog cancels on Esc and on a backdrop tap (the design-system card says not dismissible)
why: The owner's task asks for Esc and backdrop to cancel; cancelling is the safe outcome, so an easy dismiss loses nothing
evidence: Task 1.5b spec; screens/1.5b/ Esc and backdrop runs keep the line

decision: On phones (below sm) the dialog buttons always stack full width, destructive on top; side by side from sm (the card says below 360px)
why: German "Aus dem Warenkorb entfernen" plus "Abbrechen" do not fit side by side in a 343px card at 375px, and labels never wrap; one layout for both languages
evidence: First run: "Abbrechen" at x=-12 at 375px in DE; screens/1.5b/remove-dialog-de.png after the fix

decision: The cancel label is "Cancel"/"Abbrechen" (the card's "Behalten" is not used) and callers can override it with cancelLabel
why: The task names Cancel; "Behalten" reads oddly for removing a cart line

decision: The cart remove title names the gift and variant ("Remove Kapellbrücke pocket knife · Medium?"); the body gives quantity, engraving, line total and the order it leaves
why: The guest sees exactly which line goes, since two lines can share a gift

decision: After a confirmed remove, focus moves to the cart heading
why: The pressed button no longer exists; without this, focus falls to <body> and keyboard users lose their place
evidence: Script log: focus H1 "Cart", next Tab "Remove Chocolate set"

decision: C12 is styled as an obviously separate, generic provider: monospace 'Simulated payment provider · Prototype · no real money moves' strip, system font, cool greys, square corners; no serif, no product accent, no provider name, no card/wallet marks
why: Task constraint: must not look like the product or a real payment brand

decision: C12 shows only seller (shop name, 'Seller'), order reference and amount due now; no 'deposit/full' qualifier
why: Outline row 1.14 lists exactly these; avoids re-deriving payment wording outside T0

decision: Pay and Processing return to C15 with history replace; Fail stays on C12 with 'Payment declined · No money was taken' and Try again (focused)
why: Back from C15 must not land on a spent provider page; retry belongs where the failure happened, as on hosted checkouts

decision: C12 state comes from T0 startOnlinePaymentBlock: processing → 'This payment is processing', no choices; any other block → 'Nothing to pay here' + T0 block text
why: Spec §4.4 no second payment while processing, even when /pay is reopened directly

decision: Choices lock on first press (ref guard + disabled) so a double tap never makes two payments
why: After a deposit T0 allows paying the balance online, so a second tap would charge again

decision: Prototype control 'Payment provider': Provider confirms / rejects the processing payment of the order on screen (T0 resolveOnlinePayment)
why: Needed for the 'Late provider result' side path and to end a Processing payment; nothing else exposes it

decision: C06 is a route (/cart/review), not a sheet; C07 is /cart/sent?orders=<ids comma-separated>, opened with replace
why: Spec 3.1 lists /cart → C04 → C05 → C06 → C07 as pages; replace stops Back landing on an empty review

decision: C06 renders the exact order drafts that Send stores (buildOrderDrafts); all amounts from T0 selectors
why: Screen and data cannot drift; AC15 snapshot is visible before sending

decision: Per order C06 shows Order total, 'Due after the seller confirms' (CHF 0.00 for pay later), the deadline rule with the automatic cancel (deposit: balance and its date; pay later: amount and date) and the cancellation policy
why: Spec 4.2 C06, AC25; concrete dates read better than 'N days after pickup'

decision: When gifts with different cancellation texts share one order (same payment policy, date, place), the order keeps every distinct text, one paragraph each
why: Order has one cancellationPolicy field and C04 grouping ignores it; picking the first would drop a policy (AC15)

decision: Stock is checked on send, never held: the whole cart's quantity per option vs units not held by accepted orders; a short line blocks the whole send, names the gift and option, and leaves the cart and everything else unchanged with an 'Edit cart' action
why: AC05; PRD 15 'stock changed on send'; one request = all orders or none, so the guest is never left with half a request

decision: The send also re-checks dates (demo clock may pass one between C04 and C06) and shows the same error pattern pointing to the cart
why: 1.5 report: C06 must refuse lines with invalidDate

decision: Signed out on C06 (direct link): Send opens sign-in only; the guest taps Send again afterwards
why: A request should never go out without a deliberate tap after the guest sees who they are signed in as

decision: Order language = the guest's UI language at send; N02 one per order to the guest, N03 one per order to staff (staff language = UI language, T0 convention)
why: Spec 6: guest emails in the guest's language; separate orders are tracked separately

decision: Prototype control 'Make an item sell out' sets the first cart gift's option stock to the units already held (available 0); Reset restores it
why: Outline §4 control for the C06 stock-changed state

decision: Decline = reason sheet (out of stock / can't make the date / other + message, required for other), then the shared confirm AlertDialog
why: The shared ConfirmDialog has no input slot and the owner rule forbids one-off confirm dialogs; the sheet collects, the shared dialog confirms

decision: The decline reason is written in the order's language (preset text from the en/de dictionary for order.language, plus the staff message), not the staff UI language
why: It goes to the guest in N06; a DE-speaking manager must not put German into an English email
evidence: docs/ux/prototype/reports/1.11-drive.out (N06 reason check in DE run)

decision: Accept on an order already short shows the short line at once and does not open the confirmation sheet; the sheet's confirm re-checks for stock that changes while it is open
why: No sheet promising something that can't be kept; the race still lands in the same named-line Alert

decision: Change date or place is one sheet (calendar + place radios + required note); one log entry per changed field, same note; staff may pick any open day from today (Sundays closed), not limited by the product's preparation rule
why: The date was agreed with the guest by email (spec 4.6); the seller knows its preparation time

decision: Accept confirm button names the consequence: 'Accept and request CHF 26.70'; pay later: 'Accept order' with 'No payment is requested now. The guest pays CHF 24.00 after pickup, by …'
why: Spec 5.5: money actions state amount and consequence

decision: M04 desktop: two columns from 1024px, decision/gifts/guest/log left, payments/source/commission/policy right (320px); decision buttons stacked full width at every size
why: Three buttons side by side overflowed the left column at 1024px

decision: Log meta line: '{note} · {staff name} · 14.10.2026, 10:30'; actor names Owner = Chị Ngọc, Manager = Lukas, guest = guest name, system = 'System'
why: Outline step 9 log format

decision: Commission shown per line as 'basis × rate' with the rate stored on the line, total, the T0 label, and a one-line explanation (basis = gift price, recorded once on completion)
why: Spec 2.4 / O08: M04 lets staff check basis and rate

decision: C18 is a bottom sheet from C15 (product photo, name and variant; 1–5 stars; text; Post review), not a /review/{id} route
why: Owner pattern: sheets instead of new screens

decision: Star input is a 5-option radio group (arrow keys, each star labelled "n out of 5 stars"); rating and text both required, errors shown on submit
why: Keyboard and screen-reader access without a custom widget

decision: One review per product per order, id rv-<order>-<product>; a multi-product order shows one "Write a review: {name}" button per product
why: Spec §4.11: each product in the transaction gets one review

decision: The new review's reviewer line is "Purchased on {completion date}" (purchasedAt = order.completedAt), not the words "Verified purchase"
why: Accepted decision 103 replaced "Verified purchase" with the purchase date on C03

decision: Reviewer shown as first name plus last initial ("Anna K."), the same as the seeded reviews
why: Matches the seed; full surname would be personal data on a public page (spec §1.7)

decision: Review text is stored only in the language it was written in; the other language shows the existing translation notice
why: Same as other guest text; no machine translation in the prototype

decision: Already reviewed: the button is replaced inline by "Your review of {product}" (same card as C03) with a link "See it on the gift page"; no edit or delete
why: Task: button replaced by the review; editing is not in flow 1

decision: The review is posted at once (toast "Review posted. Thank you."); no merchant moderation step
why: Flow 1 scope; moderation is not in the outline

decision: C07 lists each created order as a C14-style row (photo, first gift +N, total, ref, 'Requested pickup: <short date> · <place>', T0 progress and payment chips, C06 deadline rule); each row opens that order's C15
why: Outline §2 row 1.8 and spec C07: orders, awaiting seller, next steps; the same row shape as C14 so the order is recognisable later

decision: 'What happens next' = 3 numbered steps: seller confirms (dates and places are requests until then, email when the seller answers, no response time), then pay per order with auto-cancel, then pick up on the confirmed date and place
why: Spec 4.2 step 5 (remind that the pickup date is a request), R03, AC25

decision: C07 links: 'See all in My transactions' (C14) under the orders, 'Back to Explore' as the fixed bottom button; no back arrow (C06 is replaced in history)
why: Brief: link to the order in My transactions and back to Explore

decision: C07 shows only the signed-in guest's own orders from ?orders=; none left → EmptyState 'There's no new request to show here.' + 'Back to Explore'
why: Same rule as C15 (decision 150); reload after Reset or a direct link never shows a blank screen

decision: Trip profile is an inline card on C07: travel style as radios, arrival and departure as two rows each opening a one-date Calendar sheet; each question optional; past days allowed; departure ≥ arrival enforced by the calendars
why: Spec 4.9: three optional questions; RangeCalendar would force both dates and its card reserves it for report periods; guests from a QR are often already in Lucerne

decision: Trip profile is stored per guest (DemoData.tripProfiles, optional field, no version bump); answered shows a summary with 'Edit answers'; 'Skip' collapses to one line with 'Answer now'; a skip only covers requests sent before it, so the next request asks again
why: R09: skippable, can be added and edited later (C23 is Phase 4, so no link to it)

decision: The trip card says 'Your answers don't change your pickup dates'; 'Save answers' disabled until one answer is given; clearing a date in the sheet is 'Leave empty' (not a remove action, so no confirm dialog)
why: Spec 4.9: the profile never replaces a pickup date

decision: After Skip or Save on the trip profile, focus moves to the card heading (the pressed button disappears)
why: Keyboard focus would drop to the page; same pattern as the cart remove (decision 160)

decision: M04 shows a 'Next step' card in place of the decision block once the order is past requested: one primary action per status, Complete shown locked with its T0 reason as a StatusChip ('Complete is locked: CHF 62.30 still owed'), Record payment primary while handed over and owing
why: Spec 4.7 / AC09: the lock must explain itself; tint+icon+words

decision: Ready and fully paid shows only 'Handed over and complete' (T0 handOverAndComplete), not separate Handed over / Complete buttons
why: Spec 2.1 combined button; T0 forbids two transitions in one click

decision: Ready, Handed over and Complete run on one tap, with no confirm sheet; Complete states its consequence under the button (closes order, review invite, commission recorded once). Only Record payment is a money sheet
why: Spec 5.5 confirms money actions; these steps move no money and are not delete/cancel actions

decision: Record payment is also offered on accepted orders (guest pays the first amount at the shop); T0 then moves the order to preparing
why: T0 guard allows it; spec 2.3 says Owner and Manager record outside payments

decision: M08 checks the T0 guard live: above balance = field error + disabled button; duplicate = warning Alert shown before the tap, button changes to '… again …' and pressing it confirms (allowDuplicate)
why: The warning is read before the money is saved, not after a failed tap

decision: M08 confirm sentence has one key per method ('Record CHF 62.30 cash.' / 'by bank transfer' / '(other method)'; DE 'bar' / 'per Banküberweisung' / '(andere Zahlungsart)'), 'Balance will be' / 'Danach offen:'
why: Method words change grammar per language

decision: M08 time is a 24h TimeField for today, defaulting to the demo time when the sheet opens and capped there; a later time disables the button
why: Spec 4.7 'time, defaults to now'; money can't arrive in the future

decision: Mark as handed over (and the combined button) wrapped in ProposalMark 'Handed over'
why: Outline §4: Handed over is an undecided UX proposal

decision: After each fulfilment step, focus moves to the next enabled action, or to the card heading if there is none
why: The pressed button disappears; focus must not fall to body

decision: M02 cards partition the orders: an overdue order counts only under "Payment overdue", never also under its stage; a handed-over order counts only while balance > 0
why: No order counted twice; the card says what to do, not just the stage

decision: Cards with count 0 are hidden; when all are 0 the page shows the empty state "No tasks. New requests will show up here." + "See all orders"; the three numbers always stay
why: A to-do list shows only what needs doing (spec §1.6); §5.5 empty = one sentence + one action

decision: Card links use 1.10's status values (ORDER_TABS); the overdue card opens the tab of the overdue order with the soonest pickup (awaiting-payment for a missed first payment)
why: M03 has no overdue tab; a missed balance date sits in preparing/ready/owing

decision: Still to collect = sum of T0 balance() over accepted, preparing, ready and handed_over orders; requests are excluded
why: A request owes nothing until the seller accepts (AC25)

decision: Commission to pay = recorded commission only (estimated left out); paid is 0 until payouts (M16, Phase 5)
why: Spec §2.4: commission is owed only once recorded at completion

decision: Completed this week = count of orders completed Monday–Sunday of the current Zurich week, the range shown under the number
why: A count matches "transactions completed this week"; the range removes doubt about which week

decision: M02 layout: tasks first, numbers after on phones; from 1024px tasks left and a 320px numbers column right; each card is one link with icon, title, hint, count and chevron; overdue in danger tint + icon + words
why: Spec §1.6 to-do list before figures; same column split as M04 (1.11)

decision: Card names EN Awaiting confirmation / Awaiting payment / To prepare / Ready for pickup / Payment overdue / Handed over, balance owed; DE Wartet auf Bestätigung / Wartet auf Zahlung / Vorzubereiten / Abholbereit / Zahlung überfällig / Übergeben, Restbetrag offen
why: Match the M03 tab and T0 status words where they exist

decision: P02 filters every number, group and row by the Zurich order date (spec "ngày đặt"), not the completion date, so the numbers are sums over exactly the rows shown
why: One date for everything keeps the numbers checkable by eye; a recorded commission therefore sits in the period its order was placed

decision: Commission after adjustments = recorded commission only; estimated commission on open orders is named in its hint and per group ("+CHF 11.30 estimated"), not added in
why: Spec 2.4: estimated is not earned until completion; no refunds (M10) before Phase 3, so no adjustments yet

decision: Cancelled/declined orders stay in the P02 list with "No commission" but count in no number or group
why: The partner sees the order happened; groups always add up to the headline numbers

decision: Period = primary Tabs (Day, Week, Month; default Month) plus previous/next buttons; next disabled into the future; state in the URL (?period=&date=); weeks Monday to Sunday (zurichWeek from M02)
why: Tabs card allows three tabs on phones; URL state lets the one empty-state action ("Show this month") be a plain link

decision: P02 status column shows the progress label only, with staff wording ("Cancelled by guest"); no payment label
why: The partner needs to know whether the order went ahead, not the guest's payments (R15 lists only "status")

decision: Product group = catalog category of each line, ordered as the catalog; an order spanning groups counts once in each
why: Outline §5: categories feed the P02 product-group summary

decision: P02 rows are read-only cards (phone) / Table rows (1024px, products under the guest name); nothing opens an order
why: Spec 3.3: the report is one page; the partner has no order detail screen

decision: Cart gets checkboxes (Select all + per order, or per gift) and a bottom box with each selected order's subtotal, the total for reference and Continue; unselected orders stay in the cart
why: Owner: guests choose which orders to request first; summary belongs with the Continue button (owner reference)
evidence: Lab /lab/cart-line round 3 (J by order, K by gift); spec 4.2 step 2 and C06 assume the whole cart is requested

decision: M03 phone order cards follow lab option L Pickup ticket: date-led ticket on a white surface, complete gift lines, payment status, amounts and due date each on their own row
why: Owner choice after trying the order-cards lab

decision: M03 phone rows are option L "Pickup ticket" from #/lab/order-cards; the 1024px Table is unchanged
why: Owner chose L after using the lab; the lab shows L only at phone width

decision: Phone tickets show progress as L's coloured dot + words, and payment as label/value rows, not StatusChip; the Table keeps StatusChip
why: Coordinator ruling (b): follow L exactly; words always next to the dot, all tones ≥6.4:1 on white

decision: Short payment status per order.payment.* key (merchantOrders.card.payment.*), its amounts and dates as separate rows labelled Paid / Balance / Amount / Due date
why: L puts status, amounts and due date each on their own row; the long chip label would repeat them

decision: Ticket strings (Order total, Payment) are read with useLocale inside order-rows.tsx instead of props from the route
why: Keeps the change inside features/merchant/orders; the route file is not mine

decision: M03 ticket outer surface = M02 card (rounded-3xl, shadow-surface, no border, hover:bg-surface-secondary, focus-ring); ticket's inner divider and dashed separator kept
why: Owner: same shadow pattern as other screens for consistency; inner rules don't clash on either background

decision: C04 cart lines follow lab option L Gift slip (white gift card, complete customization, full-width quantity and price row); all cards share the M02/M03 surface: rounded-3xl, shadow-surface, no border
why: Owner choice after trying the cart-line lab; owner: same shadow pattern as gift orders

decision: Cart line is Lab L "Gift slip": photo, name, option · engraving, unit price, full-width quantity + item total row
why: Owner chose L after the lab

decision: Open frame: each line card uses the M02 surface (rounded-3xl bg-surface shadow-surface, no border); the order group has no card
why: A card inside a white shadowed group would lose its edges; coordinator chose option 1

decision: Pickup date and place stay in the order header, not on each line
why: Orders are grouped by pickup date and place (R12), so one line per order says it once, as the lab does

decision: The line quantity is a bordered − n + NumberField (lab L style), not QuantityStepper
why: QuantityStepper puts its label on the left, which collides with the price in the full-width row; NumberField keeps typing and arrow keys

decision: Remove is a bin icon button (danger) top-right of the card and still asks in ConfirmDialog
why: Matches L; owner rule on deletes

decision: C04 Cart is a flat list of gift-slip lines with checkboxes (nothing selected by default, Select all); only selected lines continue to C06, which shows the split into orders (AC28 shown on C06 only; spec mapping C04,C06 -> C06). Cart note becomes an info Alert. Cart line uses the shared QuantityBox
why: Owner: orders are created at send, not when adding to cart; cart needs selection; banner needs proper info styling; one quantity control everywhere

decision: Info note is a HeroUI Alert per the design-system Alert card: status default + InfoIcon + text-info on icon and title (HeroUI has no info status); title 'Pickup dates are requests', body explains that different dates, places or payment rules become separate orders
why: Owner request 1.5d; Alert card 'our extra info status'

decision: C04 is a flat list of Gift-slip cards in cart order with each line's requested pickup and payment rule; no order headers or subtotals; the split into orders shows on C06 only (AC28 mapping 'C04, C06' → 'C06')
why: Owner request 1.5d

decision: Each line has a checkbox, with Select all on top (indeterminate when some are ticked); nothing is ticked by default or on add; C06 and Send use the ticked lines only; unticked lines stay in the cart after Send
why: Owner request 1.5d

decision: The selection is stored as CartLine.selected in the demo store and survives a reload and a Back from C06 (option A)
why: Coordinator answer: nothing pre-selected is the rule; keeping the guest's own ticks respects it

decision: Continue explains instead of disabling: nothing ticked → 'Select the gifts you want to request first.' and focus on Select all; a ticked line with an invalid date → the 1.5 message and focus on that line's fix button; an unticked invalid line does not block
why: 1.5 pattern; owner request 1.5d

decision: Bar label counts the ticked gifts (quantities): 'Total for 2 selected gifts, for reference'; 'Total for reference CHF 0.00' when nothing is ticked
why: Same gift count as the header and the cart badge

decision: The checkbox accessible name includes option and date ('Select Kapellbrücke pocket knife · Medium, Wed 21 Oct')
why: Two lines can be the same gift

decision: 'Make an item sell out' targets the first ticked line and is disabled when nothing is ticked
why: Otherwise the C06 stock error cannot be reached when the first line is not ticked

decision: Line quantity uses the shared QuantityBox (components/quantity-stepper)
why: Owner request 1.5d; one stepper for C03 and C04

decision: Cart line shows the store name, a highlighted item price, no item total, and two pickup rows with icons (request date, place). Pricing breakdown moves to a bottom sheet; Select all lives in the always-visible bottom bar. Info notes are real tinted Alerts (tint background, soft status border, icon, coloured title)
why: Owner feedback on C04 after 1.5d

decision: Space above the bar: the bar is sticky in the cart's own flow and the route opts out of the shell's tab-bar padding (staticData.ownsBottomSpace); gap after the last card is 20px whatever the bar height
